# Plane endpoint map

<!-- Generated by `packages/warpmetal-cli/scripts/gen-plane-docs.mjs`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool in the Plane surface, the request it builds, and the vendor call site the
request was read from. Origin: `https://api.plane.so`, prefix `/api/v1`, credential in the
`x-api-key` header, workspace slug from the `plane.workspace_slug` secret.

`sdk` is the member `fetch-inventory.mjs` recorded for that action: the same string
the pinned release calls, and the validator refuses an entry whose endpoint names
any other call site. `arguments` says where each of the action's arguments goes.

| Tool | Request | Path | sdk | Arguments | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plane_customer_list` | GET | `/workspaces/{workspace}/customers` | `customers.list` | path: -; query: query, cursor, per_page (workspace path) |  |
| `plane_customer_retrieve` | GET | `/workspaces/{workspace}/customers/{customer_id}` | `customers.retrieve` | path: customer_id (workspace path) |  |
| `plane_customer_list_workitems` | GET | `/workspaces/{workspace}/customers/{customer_id}/issues` | `work_items.list` | path: customer_id; query: customer_request_id, search (workspace path) | The work items linked to one customer; the vendor reaches it through its work-item resource. |
| `plane_customer_property_list` | GET | `/workspaces/{workspace}/customer-properties` | `properties.list` | path: -; query: cursor, per_page (workspace path) |  |
